curator_note: Miss Bashful's 360 night is a eurodance-meets-trance-meets-electroclash costume-y throwback party. It's late and loud at Exchange, but it's more nostalgia than club-night selection.
description: Late-night eurodance, trance and electroclash party at Exchange in DTLA, 10pm.

curator_note: A 4-year anniversary for a collective running out to an undisclosed Inland Empire spot, so you're signing up for a drive. I can't vouch for the lineup, but anniversary editions usually bring the regulars out.
description: Kenopsic's 4th anniversary party, 10:30pm, venue TBA in the Inland Empire about 45 minutes from LA.

curator_note: Easy Saturday if you want sing-along indie and dance-floor crossover in Echo Park at $21. It's a recurring party, so treat it as a fun fallback, not a destination.
description: Recurring indie rock and electronic dance party at the Echoplex, 9pm, 21+.

curator_note: Rommii headlines her own 360 night at Exchange, a house set in a big downtown room. I haven't heard enough of her to say how deep it goes, so check a mix first.
description: House night billed around Rommii at Exchange in DTLA, 10pm to 3am.

curator_note: Night Tales is a UK-born party brand that books melodic, progressive-leaning house. The Thanksgiving-weekend Friday at The Spotlight is a cheap $25 way to get a proper dance floor.
description: Night Tales progressive house night at The Spotlight, Friday 10pm to 2:30am.

curator_note: Free tech and funky house that runs 10pm to 6am at Apotheke. The bill is local to me, so the price and the hours are the draw.
description: Free tech and funky house night at Apotheke in Chinatown, 10pm to 6am, with Michael Fam, Sir. Roscoe and DJ Shroomie.

curator_note: Late Thanksgiving-night deep house and minimal from the Recollect Afters crew for $8. It's a low-stakes way to dance off the turkey, though the venue is only listed as Los Angeles.
description: Recollect Underground Thanksgiving-night party with LAVENGE, 11pm, deep house, deep tech and minimal.
